title: Eggsplode
description: Craft exploding eggs - throw them - MAYHEM
body:
## Thanks for downloading Eggsplode !!

**Eggsplode** is a simple fun datapack adding 2 exploding eggs (_+4 for the variants_)

I had the idea of this datapack by playing some Lethal Company !

To craft those **2 new eggs**, you will need some **gunpowder** (and an egg of course, and it's **shapeless** !)

Put 2 gunpowders and an egg in a crafting table to get an **Eggsplode** (what a nice word play)
Put 8 gunpowders and you'll get a true weapon of destruction :) Have fun !

![Craft of an Eggsplode, requiring two gunpowders and an egg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9216c31da95616b17029359a64dd0d7b2f610249.png)

![Craft on a Charged Eggsplode, requiring eight gunpowders and an egg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7e9a0fb964dda3d948db6d1a0723558e39432f5.png)
